The fastest way to reach us is WhatsApp on +66 63 704 0888, answered every day from 08:00 to 20:00 Thailand time (UTC+7). Email suits anything with documents or long itineraries. To book a trip, use Book now on the tour page; for private boats, groups of 10 or more and villas, send an enquiry and we reply with a quote and a payment link. In an emergency on the island, call 1669 for an ambulance, 191 for police or 1155 for the Tourist Police.

[kp_wa]WhatsApp us[/kp_wa]

It's [kp_time] on Koh Samui right now. Messages sent after 20:00 are answered from 08:00 the next morning, and emails are answered during the same hours. If your trip is tomorrow, WhatsApp is always faster than email.

What to include in your message

A complete first message saves a round of questions. Please send:

  • Your name and, if you have booked, your booking reference.
  • The trip or boat you want, and your date (and a back-up date in the monsoon months, October to December).
  • The number of guests, split into adults (12+), children (3–11) and infants (0–2).
  • Your hotel or villa name and area, so we can confirm pickup. Nathon, Lipa Noi, Taling Ngam, Bang Kao, Thong Krut and other remote areas add 400 THB per person, return.
  • Your WhatsApp number with country code, if you are writing by email.
  • For private boats: the route you have in mind, start time and any lunch or transfer needs.

Enquiry form

Use the form for private boats, groups of 10 or more, villas and activities that are sold by quote. Tell us your date, guests and what you are interested in, and we reply with availability, a price in THB and a secure payment link. The booking is confirmed by email or WhatsApp once payment is received. For shared tours, it is quicker to book on the trip page: online booking for tomorrow closes at midnight Thailand time, and same-day requests go to WhatsApp.

Our office

Our Koh Samui office is on Chaweng Beach Road in Bo Phut (84320), on the east coast. It is a working booking desk rather than a walk-in shop, so please message us before you visit and we'll tell you when someone is there.

Already booked?

  • Your confirmation: we confirm every paid booking by email or WhatsApp. Check your spam folder if you booked by card and haven't heard from us within a few hours during 08:00–20:00.
  • Your pickup time: arrives by email or WhatsApp the evening before your trip. Be ready in your hotel lobby 5 minutes early.
  • Changes and cancellations: message us with your booking reference. Day trips are fully refundable 48 hours or more before departure; Ang Thong tours are fully refundable 48 hours or more before departure and not after. The full rules are in our terms and cancellation policy.
  • Weather: if we cancel for weather or sea safety, you choose a full refund or a new date. Live readings are on our sea conditions page.

Emergencies on the island

We are a booking team, not an emergency service. If someone is hurt or in danger, call these numbers first, then tell us if it affects a trip.

ServiceNumber
Ambulance and medical emergency1669
Police191
Tourist Police (English spoken, 24 h)1155
Fire199
TAT tourist information1672

Our guides list the island's hospitals and the Tourist Police office, and the safety guide covers sea, road and jellyfish risks.
